title: 第一卷 第5章 解决噬魂引第一卷 第6章 九灵
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 一般来说，六品灵兽内丹在坊市里的正常行情都是两千块下品灵石一枚。
对方喊出一千块灵石，确实是实打实的半价出售。
可即便如此，曹阳现在也根本买不起。
不过，他依然打算过去看一眼。
毕竟六品的好东西可不多见。
曹阳顺着声音凑了过去，远远看去，摊位前围了不少人。
可奇怪的是，很多修士听到一千块灵石一枚的六品内丹，起初都面露兴奋，但只要一走近，仔细打量两眼后，却全都无一例外连连摇头，转身就走。
这让曹阳心里犯起了嘀咕。
正所谓有便宜不占王八蛋，散修更是如此，这么大的便宜，难道都没人占？
即便是转手都能赚一千啊？
曹阳裹紧了黑袍，挤到摊位前。
破布上摆着两个灰扑扑的玉盒，里面各自躺着一颗鸽子蛋大小，散发着淡淡灵气波动的珠子。
“道友，这内丹怎么卖？”曹阳故意哑着嗓子问道。
摊主是个尖嘴猴腮的老头，眼皮一掀，冷哼道，“一千块灵石一枚，谢绝还价。”
曹阳没再开口，目光落在那两枚内丹上，心念一动，暗中催动了阴阳造化鼎。
不多时，一道信息直接反馈到了他的脑海中。
曹阳眼底闪过一丝恍然。
怪不得那些人看了就走。
这特么根本不是什么灵兽内丹，而是妖兽内丹！
灵兽和妖兽，虽然只有一字之差，但却是天壤之别。
灵兽的修炼方式是吸收天地灵气，内丹纯粹温和，修士可以直接用来炼丹或者吸收。
而妖兽则是靠着吞噬血食来修行的。
它们的血食包括妖兽同类、灵兽，甚至是人类修士！
因此，妖兽内丹里充斥着极其狂暴的暴戾之气。
人类修士若是服用妖兽内丹，轻则经脉寸断修为尽失，重则当场爆体而亡。
这老头不知用了什么邪门手段，把妖兽内丹表面的煞气遮掩了起来，伪装成了灵兽内丹。
那些离开的修士，显然都是看穿了这层伪装。
也难怪他敢半价叫卖，这玩意儿白送给别人，别人都嫌催命。
不过，别人怕妖兽内丹，曹阳可不怕啊。
对于阴阳造化鼎来说，管你是灵兽内丹还是妖兽内丹，只要是丹，就可以融合。
拿妖兽内丹搭配噬魂引，说不定还有奇效呢。
曹阳不动声色，做出一副极其眼热却又囊中羞涩的纠结模样，搓着手说道：“老丈，东西是好东西，可一千块灵石实在太贵了，我这倾家荡产也凑不出这么多啊，能不能便宜点？”
“没钱你凑什么热闹？滚滚滚。”老头不耐烦地挥手。
content_en:
Generally speaking, the normal price of a sixth-grade spirit beast inner elixir in the market is 2,000 yuan per low-grade spirit stone.
The other party shouted out a thousand spiritual stones, which was indeed half price.
But even so, Cao Yang can't afford it now.
However, he still planned to go over and take a look.
After all, good things of the sixth grade are rare.
Cao Yang followed the sound and moved closer. Looking from a distance, he saw many people gathered in front of the stall.
But the strange thing is that many monks were excited at first when they heard about the sixth-grade inner elixir worth a thousand spiritual stones. But as soon as they got closer and took a closer look, they all shook their heads without exception and turned around and left.
This made Cao Yang murmur in his heart.
As the saying goes, don't take advantage of the bastard, and this is especially true for casual cultivators. Is it possible that no one can take advantage of such a huge advantage?
Even if it changes hands, you can make a thousand dollars?
Cao Yang wrapped his black robe tightly and squeezed to the stall.
There were two dusty jade boxes placed on the rags. Inside each lay a bead the size of a dove egg, exuding light fluctuations of spiritual energy.
"Fellow Taoist, how do you sell this inner elixir?" Cao Yang asked in a deliberately hoarse voice.
The stall owner was an old man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks. He raised his eyelids and snorted coldly, "One thousand spiritual stones. No counter-offer."
Cao Yang didn't speak again, his eyes fell on the two inner elixirs, and with a thought in his mind, he secretly activated the Yin-Yang Creation Cauldron.
Not long after, a piece of information was directly fed back to his mind.
A flash of realization flashed in Cao Yang's eyes.
No wonder those people left after seeing it.
This is not a spiritual beast inner elixir at all, but a monster beast inner elixir!
Although there is only one word difference between spiritual beast and monster beast, they are worlds apart.
The cultivation method of spiritual beasts is to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. The inner elixir is pure and gentle, and monks can directly use it to refine elixirs or absorb them.
The monsters cultivate by devouring blood.
Their blood food includes fellow monsters, spiritual beasts, and even human monks!
Therefore, the inner elixir of the monster beast is filled with extremely violent and violent energy.
If a human monk takes the inner elixir of a monster, his meridians may be severed and his cultivation will be lost, or his body may explode and die on the spot.
The old man didn't know what evil means he used to cover up the evil aura on the surface of the demonic beast's inner elixir, and disguised it as a spiritual beast's inner elixir.
Those monks who left had obviously seen through this disguise.
No wonder he dared to sell it at half price, giving it to others for free, and others thought it was a rush.
However, while others are afraid of the inner elixir of monsters, Cao Yang is not afraid.
For the Yin-Yang Creation Cauldron, it doesn’t matter whether you are a spirit beast inner elixir or a monster beast inner elixir, as long as it is an elixir, you can fuse it.
Combining the demonic beast inner elixir with the soul-devouring guide may have miraculous effects.
Cao Yang remained calm, making a tangled look that was extremely hot-eyed but cash-strapped. He rubbed his hands and said, "Old man, these things are good, but a thousand spiritual stones are too expensive. I'm broke and can't get so much. Can it be cheaper?"
"Why are you joining in the fun if you don't have money? Guangguangguan." The old man waved his hand impatiently.
